text:
Maya (DevEx): quick sync — final cutover checklist for this week's SDK/docs/samplekit release. changelog freeze is tomorrow EOD PST. who needs an explicit owner ping?
Sam (SDK): I'm owning the v1.4 SDK changelog slice and the release notes PR. will ping reviewers now. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/784
Priya (Docs): Docs freeze impact: sample quickstarts need screenshots + config snippets updated. i can take screenshots if the sampleapps CI is green. who's running the samplekit smoke?
Jing (QA): Jing here — i'll run the smoke harness on staging at 11:30 PT tomorrow. call out any flaky tests now; i'll add to the temp ignore list.
Alex (Platform): FYI, staging infra autoscaler has a known hiccup with g4dn during parallel jobs — we've reduced concurrency on samplekit CI to 2x for the next 24h.
Sam (SDK): noted. also heads-up: a small API change in auth flow (token refresh) landed in sdk-core. i opened a migration note in the changelog PR. Priya please add a migration snippet?
Priya (Docs): on it. can you drop the sample cli commands here? small code block is easiest.
Sam (SDK): sure — `redwood auth refresh --env staging` and `export REDWOOD_TOKEN=$(cat ~/.redwood/token)` — added to PR comment.
Maya (DevEx): ownership check: who will cut the samplekit release tag? i can do it if no one else has bandwidth.
Sam (SDK): i can cut the sdk tag after PR merge (i'm on call for reviews until 10am PT). prefer me to do it to coordinate with release notes.
Maya (DevEx): great — Sam tags SDK. Jing will run smoke. Priya updates screenshots + migration snippet. Alex keeps CI throttled. i'll coordinate the changelog merge and the release announcement draft.
DocsBot: Reminder: docs site build scheduled at 12:00 PT. Any changes merged after 11:45 PT may miss the build.
Priya (Docs): thanks — i'll target screenshots in the next 90 mins and open a docs PR by 10:45 PT.
Jing (QA): if CI flakes, i'll post the failed job URL here and tag the responsible owner. please be ready for a quick revert if needed.
Sam (SDK): reviewers @alex @maya — quick CR please, should be small. I'll wait for thumbs before merging. :pray:
Alex (Platform): pinged in the PR. i'll review in the next hour.
Maya (DevEx): small ask — can someone verify quickstart env vars in the sampleapp README? a file mismatch caused last-minute docs gap last release.
Sam (SDK): i updated README env vars in the samplekit PR — double-checked names match sdk config.
Priya (Docs): will validate and run the local quickstart to confirm screenshots are reproducible.
ReleaseBot: Scheduled: changelog freeze at 2026-03-18T23:59:00Z. Will prevent merges to /changelog after cutoff.
Maya (DevEx): final note: if anyone expects to merge after freeze, post here and justify. otherwise i'll merge consolidated changelog at 11:50 PT and ship the announcement draft for review. :shipit:
Sam (SDK): no late merges from SDK side. thanks.
Jing (QA): smoke run ok plan set. i'll post results. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Docs): docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/459 — contains screenshots + migration snippet.
Maya (DevEx): perfect — i'll take the changelog PR and close the loop. thanks team! :tada:
